# Direct shared CSS mappings preserve the public skin URL while removing platform wrappers

The cleanup deletes six platform wrapper families and maps the same public root/downloads skin URLs directly to shared physical files. Selected Account Central and Downloads consumers keep those public URLs; the corresponding /shared aliases are removed. Keep resource URL, physical source and actual consumer distinct when reviewing this packaging change. This source comparison does not prove all stylesheet consumers, successful packaging or pixel equivalence.

Scope: Thunderbird theme packaging and consumers.
